by_rule.description: AGENTS.md must be linked with rel:'agents' and type text/markdown
README.md must be linked with rel:'describedby' and type text/markdown
every object matches the Portolan profile schema it declares
geospatial collections must include a thumbnail asset (png or jpeg)
a mirror should link the upstream STAC with rel:'canonical' when one exists
